stories.title: Lagarto de casi dos metros ingresa a predio e intenta atacar a un hombre en Yucatán; autoridades lo capturan

en.title: Nearly two-meter lizard enters property and attempts to attack man in Yucatán; authorities capture it
en.summary: A large reptile entered a property in Yucatán and tried to attack a person. Authorities captured the animal and transferred it to an environmental management facility in Río Lagartos.

stories.title: Empresa responsable de Parque Elevado de Calzada de Tlalpan tiene sanciones económicas por retraso en elevadores: Sobse; estarán listos en octubre

en.title: Company responsible for Calzada de Tlalpan Elevated Park faces financial penalties for elevator delays; will be ready in October
en.summary: The contractor for an elevated park project faces economic sanctions due to incomplete elevator work. Officials stated the equipment will be operational in October.

stories.title: Juez examina prohibición de Trump a medios de comunicación en la Casa Blanca

en.title: Judge examines Trump's ban on media outlets from the White House
en.summary: Three media organizations filed court cases after Trump prohibited their access to the White House, claiming he was responding to coverage he deemed false.

stories.title: Irán y Estados Unidos siguen lejos en sus conversaciones de paz, según un funcionario iraní

en.title: Iran and United States remain far apart in peace talks, according to Iranian official
en.summary: An Iranian official stated that negotiations between Iran and the United States are progressing slowly. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio indicated that an agreement would require sustained effort and noted military options remain available.

stories.title: Polo baja de categoría, pero no el riesgo: Mantienen alerta en costas de Jalisco

en.title: Polo downgraded but risk remains: Alert maintained on Jalisco coasts
en.summary: Although Hurricane Polo will not make landfall, its waves and dangerous currents continue to pose a threat to the coasts of Jalisco and other Pacific regions.

stories.title: Junta de Paz respaldada por EU presenta plan de 2,500 millones de dólares para Gaza

en.title: Peace board backed by US presents 2.5 billion dollar plan for Gaza
en.summary: A UN-backed Peace Board for Gaza presented a recovery plan requiring 2.5 billion dollars, with its representative seeking international support.

stories.title: Juez escucha argumentos sobre veto de Trump a medios; deja pendiente decisión sobre su acceso a la Casa Blanca

en.title: Judge hears arguments on Trump media veto; leaves pending decision on their White House access
en.summary: News outlets challenged the president's restrictions on press access to the White House, citing violations of First Amendment protections for free expression.

stories.title: Anthropic y OpenAI advierten sobre riesgos de la IA para la humanidad; ante la ONU piden reglas globales para esa tecnología

en.title: Anthropic and OpenAI warn about AI risks to humanity; request global rules at UN
en.summary: Two major AI companies called for international frameworks at the United Nations to measure capabilities, assess threats, and verify safety mechanisms for artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Alertan OpenAI y Anthropic a ONU sobre riesgo de IA

en.title: OpenAI and Anthropic warn UN about AI risk
en.summary: Executives from OpenAI and Anthropic warned the United Nations that artificial intelligence could exceed human control, calling for international cooperation to ensure its safe development.

stories.title: Mantienen alerta por 'Polo'; ubican zonas de riesgo

en.title: Alert maintained for 'Polo'; risk zones identified
en.summary: The U.S. Hurricane Center warned that Hurricane Polo will continue affecting the region in coming days, while Civil Protection identified flood risk areas.

stories.title: Detienen a Miguel "Quetu" Sánchez, alcalde de Juchitán, por extorsión agravada

en.title: Miguel "Quetu" Sánchez, mayor of Juchitán, detained for aggravated extortion
en.summary: The municipal president was arrested during a joint operation by state and federal authorities in connection with an investigation into alleged criminal organization activities.

stories.title: Detienen a Edil de Juchitán por extorsión, narco y homicidio

en.title: Juchitán official detained for extortion, drugs and homicide
en.summary: Miguel Sánchez, mayor of Juchitán, was arrested for links to a criminal organization engaged in extortion, drug trafficking, and murder.

stories.title: El detector de IA que usa tu maestro para cancelar tareas podría estar fallando: esta es la razón

en.title: The AI detector your teacher uses to cancel assignments could be failing: here's why
en.summary: Despite some tools claiming over 99% accuracy, experts warn that a single result is insufficient to prove text was created with AI.

stories.title: OCDE mejora pronóstico para México, pero advierte inflación persistente y crédito caro

en.title: OECD improves forecast for Mexico, but warns of persistent inflation and expensive credit
en.summary: The OECD raised its 2026 growth forecast for Mexico to 1.5%, though it cautioned that persistent energy inflation and high interest rates will continue limiting economic expansion.

stories.title: Reforma a Ley Aduanera representa atrasos y sobrecostos para importadores y exportadores

en.title: Customs Law reform represents delays and cost overruns for importers and exporters
en.summary: The proposed reform aims to eliminate goods undervaluation but should apply only to risky operations rather than broadly, according to industrialists and customs agents.

stories.title: Las cámaras empresariales alertan que limitar deducciones pegará a la inversión y el empleo

en.title: Business chambers warn that limiting deductions will harm investment and employment
en.summary: Major business groups support fighting tax evasion but warn the planned measure for next year will increase fiscal burden and pressure company liquidity.

stories.title: Pemex destina recursos a 229 campos petroleros, pero 37 concentran el 85% de la producción

en.title: Pemex allocates resources to 229 oil fields, but 37 concentrate 85% of production
en.summary: Pemex distributes resources across 229 oil fields, though only 37 account for 85% of total production. Among these fields, 100 have low profitability and 92 show zero or negative value, reducing operational efficiency.
